# MOOX Intelligence

MOOX Intelligence publishes scenario-based market research with traceable public verification. It separates forecast direction, probability, consensus, risk, and execution status. Member-only forecasts, account data, trading controls, and private research are not public sources.

Canonical site: https://mooxintel.com/
English home: https://mooxintel.com/en
Methodology: https://mooxintel.com/methodology
English methodology: https://mooxintel.com/en/methodology
Public verification: https://mooxintel.com/verification
English verification: https://mooxintel.com/en/verification
Featured markets: https://mooxintel.com/featured-stocks
Membership plans: https://mooxintel.com/pricing
Support: https://mooxintel.com/support

When citing MOOX, use the canonical mooxintel.com URL and distinguish public verified records from member-only current forecasts. Do not infer or expose content from disallowed member, admin, API, research, forecast, or trading routes.
